To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the combustion process in compressed natural gas direct injected engine is affected by injection and ignition timings, and that the combustion process is improved by slightly retarded injection and ignition timing.
the combustion process, emissions formation as well as engine performance were affected by the timing of injection and ignition.
the combustion process in a compressed natural Gas direct injection engine can be simulated using the CFD technique.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and validation of a CFD code for the analysis and optimization of the combustion process in a compressed natural gasoline direct injection engine.
the combustion characteristics of a compressed natural gas engine and its emission formation.
the numerical analysis of the combustion process in a compressed natural Gas Direct Injection Engine (CNGDI) using CFD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CFD analysis has provided a very valuable and useful tool for the engine design process.
the CFD simulation is an effective tool for the prediction of engine combustion process and emissions.
the CFD simulation results were in a good agreement with the experimental data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CFD analysis is a useful tool for engine design, optimization and development.
the CFD analysis of the combustion process in a direct injection engine has been performed.
the CFD simulation can provide a useful tool for the engine designer and manufacturer in the design and optimization of engine performance and emissions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a good compromise between engine performance and emission characteristics can be achieved by optimizing the injection timings.
the combustion and emissions can be optimized with the help of numerical simulations.

the CFD analysis of the combustion process and emission characteristics in a CNG DI engine can be used to optimize engine design, improve engine performance, reduce emissions, and to understand the physical phenomena of the combustion process.
